pause.title: Paused
pause.subtitle: The Vale holds its breath.
pause.footer: Esc resumes · abandoning returns to the Hub and keeps nothing.
pause.abandonConfirmBody: This ends the run now and returns to the Hub. Nothing from it is kept.
pause.autoPickOnNote: Level-ups resolve themselves: the highest-rank boon you already own, or the first card offered.
pause.autoPickOffNote: Level-ups pause the run for your choice.
pause.fullscreenNote: Fullscreen also works from the Hub's Settings tab.
